description: In 2012, the Washington Supreme Court issued a decision—the McCleary decision—that mandated the Legislature fix a disparity between schools in relatively affluent areas from those in others. The Legislature enacted a new funding model that tried to fix this problem by increasing state funding overall but limiting how much money schools could raise to pay
